To enrich the artistic concept of the urban life exhibition, elements from the hip-hop genre can be integrated by designing visual installations that mimic the rhythmic, syncopated beats and lyrical flow of hip-hop tracks. For instance, lighting could pulse in time with the characteristic drum patterns, while projected text or graffiti-style art could reflect the narrative and flow of hip-hop lyrics, thereby echoing the energetic and gritty atmosphere of city living through a multi-sensory experience.
